title: What Should a Large Language Model See? Physical Invariants as a Data Representation for PDE Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2608.25189v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how molecular interactions govern macroscopic behaviour is a central challenge in molecular sciences. However, conventional theory building cannot keep pace with the vast datasets modern experimentation routinely produces. Large language models offer a promising route to automating theory construction, but a spatiotemporal field cannot be directly placed in a prompt. Existing models generally learn about the data only through a score measuring how well each proposal fits it. Here we introduce data interpretation, a stage that measures the field into the quantities a theorist would consult and supplies them to the model as a direct input. On a benchmark of simulated fields, interpretation nearly triples the accuracy of recovered equations relative to showing the raw data, at negligible computational cost and without any training. translated_title: 大型语言模型应当“看见”什么？物理不变量作为偏微分方程发现的数据表示
translated_abstract: 摘要：理解分子相互作用如何支配宏观行为是分子科学中的一个核心挑战。然而，传统理论构建的速度无法跟上现代实验所产生的大量数据集。大型语言模型为自动化理论构建提供了一条有前景的途径，但时空场无法直接放入提示中。现有模型通常仅通过一个评分来了解数据，该评分衡量每个提议与数据的匹配程度。在此，我们引入了数据解释这一阶段，它将场测量为理论家会参考的量，并将其作为直接输入提供给模型。在一组模拟场的基准测试中，与展示原始数据相比，解释方法将恢复方程的准确率提高了近三倍，且计算成本可忽略不计，无需任何训练。通过让语言模型像理论家一样读取场数据，数据解释提供了一种……
tldr: 本文提出“数据解释”阶段，将时空场转化为物理不变量作为大语言模型的直接输入，从而在不训练的情况下将偏微分方程发现的准确率提升近三倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "data interpretation" stage that converts spatiotemporal fields into physical invariants as direct inputs for large language models, nearly tripling the accuracy of PDE discovery without training.
